headline: Approved $160,000 Dispatch transfer, $150,000 park transfer, eminent domain taking, and several licenses, leases, and appointments.
summary: The council approved budget transfers of $160,000 for Dispatch Department operations and $150,000 for park projects after public hearings. It also approved an eminent domain taking at 171 Brimbal Avenue, several business license renewals, school district equipment leases, two Parking and Traffic Commission reappointments, and received amended animal ordinance language. A National Grid hearing on Broadway underground work was continued to March 2, 2026, and a related Cabot Street petition was withdrawn.
